messages.subject: include nonwear vs. ignore nonwear
parts:
Hi Dr. Van Hees,

Thank you so much for your support on this Google group! 

I have ran into an issue regarding the code ignorenonwear=XX. I think I might have misunderstood the function of this code. 

Backgroup of the study: I am working on a study in which participants wear Actigraph for >=22 hours/d verified by CentrePoint. They also report information regarding their time of sleep onset and waking up, which we are using as the sleep log. 

Inital issue: after processing the data using sleep log as the guider and vanHees2015 for SIB detection, I noticed that, in part 4 QC file, waking up times match up pretty reasonablly; however,  the sleep onset time based on SIB is typically 1-2 hours behind the sleep log sleep onset time. Since the wear time was verified first by CentrePoint, I wanted to see if we can factor in nonwear time and see if this will close the gap for sleep onset. 

Curernt issue: I used the code ignorenonwear=XX, and toggled between TRUE and FALSE, and then compared part 4 QC files.  I did see additional days included when ignorenonwear=FALSE. Which makes sense to me since they need to have 22 hours to be considered having a valid day. However, the sleep onset time are still exactly the same between ignorenonwear=TURE or FALSE (please see Excel attached, happy to provide any additonal documentation). This is not what I was expecting since I thought the sleep onset time based on SIB would move to earlier time during the day after considering nonwear time. 

Could you (or anyone) let me know if I am not using this code correctly? Thank you so much in advance!!

Best,
Yin
